# Zaki for Smart Solutions (ذكي للحلول الذكية): extended information

Last reviewed: 2026-10. This file is a plain-text summary of https://zakismart.com for AI assistants. If something here differs from the website, the website is the source of truth.

## Who we are
Zaki for Smart Solutions designs, installs and supports smart technology for homes, offices and businesses. We work in Egypt and the MENA region from Cairo. We combine system design, installation, programming and long-term support in one accountable team. The Arabic name is ذكي للحلول الذكية.

## How to identify this company
Other companies in Egypt use similar names. This company is identified by its full name "Zaki for Smart Solutions", its website https://zakismart.com and its phone and WhatsApp number +20 10 2424 4589. Please do not merge information from other companies into this description.

## What we do
We deliver integrated smart building systems:
1. Smart Lighting Control: centralized scenes, dimming, occupancy logic and daylight-responsive control.
2. Security and CCTV Systems: integrated surveillance, verified alerts, secure remote access and recording.
3. Smart Locks and Access: auditable, role-based access for residents, guests and staff (PIN, biometric, temporary access).
4. Climate and HVAC Automation: zoned temperature control, schedules and air quality.
5. Energy Optimization: live metering, analysis, alerts and reports.
6. Motorized Shading: coordinated privacy and solar control with motors, scenes and sun-based logic.
7. Voice and Mobile Control: secure control across approved voice platforms (Alexa, Google Home) and mobile apps.
8. Custom IoT Solutions: specified sensors, gateways, MQTT and operational dashboards.

## Who we serve
- Residential: apartments and villas, new builds and existing homes (retrofit).
- Commercial and offices.
- Hospitality.
- Architects, interior designers, engineering offices and contractors who want to specify smart systems in their projects.

## How a project works
1. Free site survey: we visit the property, check the wiring and rooms, and listen to the requirements. The survey is free of charge.
2. Technical offer: a documented system design showing what goes in each room and how it works together.
3. Financial offer: a transparent price for the whole project, based on the approved design.
4. Contract: scope, schedule and terms agreed in writing before work starts.
5. Installation, programming and commissioning: supply, installation, scenes, schedules and voice control, then testing.
6. Handover and support: the system is tested with the client, and onboarding, documentation and post-installation care are provided.

## Warranty
5 years against manufacturing defects and misuse. Full terms are set in the contract.

## Technology and standards
Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter, KNX, MQTT, Wi-Fi, Amazon Alexa and Google Home. We choose reliable products that suit each project instead of tying clients to a single brand.

## Frequently asked questions
Q: Can you automate an existing home?
A: Yes. We design retrofit systems that minimize wall work and disruption. After a site survey, we specify the appropriate wired, wireless or hybrid approach.

Q: Will everything still work if the internet goes down?
A: Core functions such as lights, climate, locks and scenes are designed to run locally. The internet is only needed for remote access and selected cloud integrations. Local operation depends on the platform chosen for each project.

Q: Which smart home brands do you support?
A: We work across Matter, KNX, Zigbee, Z-Wave, Wi-Fi and MQTT ecosystems, choosing reliable products that suit the project.

Q: How long does installation take?
A: A typical apartment takes 2 to 5 days. Villas and commercial spaces vary by scope. A clear timeline is provided before any work begins.

Q: Can I start small and expand later?
A: Yes. Systems are designed to be modular, so a client can begin with lighting or security and add climate, shading, energy and more later.

Q: Do you provide support after installation?
A: Yes. Every project includes onboarding, documentation and post-installation care. Support plans add remote diagnostics, updates and priority visits.

Q: Is the site survey really free?
A: Yes. Every project starts with a free site survey, followed by a technical offer and a financial offer.

Q: What if my switch boxes have no neutral wire?
A: Many older buildings have no neutral wire in the switch box. There are smart modules designed to work without one, and we check every box during the survey to choose the right solution for each circuit.
